name: Dots Bounce
description: Three dots bounce up and down with staggered timing like a typing indicator

variations.name: default
variations.description: Dots in a horizontal row bounce upward sequentially with staggered delays creating a wave-like typing indicator

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
